output.summary: The denial was due to missing required supporting documentation. Submit the physician’s medical necessity letter and clinical progress notes to satisfy the policy’s physiotherapy limit clause.

items.text: A physician’s letter of medical necessity is required.
Clinical progress notes showing functional improvement are required.
Request the treating physician to provide a signed letter of medical necessity referencing the physiotherapy sessions.
Collect and submit the therapist’s progress notes documenting each session’s outcomes.
Without the required physician letter and progress notes, the appeal cannot proceed.
